title: France to Expel Two Iranian Diplomats, Foreign Minister Says

summary: Iran has sent Washington a list of demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz that’s so uncompromising, it seems designed for rejection. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Marc Champion explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)
